scraped_replies.html:
Hi:

All about laser safety is in Section 10 of the datasheet, where you can find the information. If not exist, then this information is confidential that cannot be shared publicly. Thank you for your understanding.

Datasheet - VL53L8CX - Low-power high-performance 8x8 multizone Time-of-Flight (ToF) sensor

Best Regards,

Bin FAN
